context: Tests the When Not to Use boundary: purely generative tasks need no captured evidence.

checklist.name: Provides the function in the reply
checklist.description: The reply contains a TypeScript `slugify` function.

checklist.name: Does not create evidence files
checklist.description: The agent writes no file under `.context/evidence/` or any other evidence directory.

checklist.name: Does not take a screenshot
checklist.description: The agent does not call a screenshot tool.

checklist.name: Does not capture logs or run commands only for evidence
checklist.description: The agent does not run `tee` or redirect output to save logs for this task.

checklist.name: Does not append an Evidence table
checklist.description: The reply has no `## Evidence` summary table.

checklist.name: Honours the explicit no-files request
checklist.description: The reply follows the user's instruction not to create or save other files.

checklist.name: Explains why no artifact is captured
checklist.description: If it mentions evidence at all, it says that no external state was observed.

checklist.name: Code replaces spaces with hyphens
checklist.description: The function replaces spaces with hyphens.
